column1: # Verified additions to the upstream Skretzo/shortest-path transport data.
# Columns (tab separated, same as the generated resource):
#   category
# Trailing requirement columns may be omitted. Blank means "no requirement".
# RULES FOR ADDING A ROW HERE
#   1. Prove the tile is blocked in collision-map.zip. A route that merely looks
#      wrong is not evidence - decode the region and read the flag.
#   2. Prove upstream has no row for it. Search the whole bounding box, not the
#      single tile, and not just for the object type you expect.
#   3. Add BOTH directions, and every tile of the opening.
#   4. Record the evidence in the comment above the rows. A future reader must be
#      able to re-check the claim without redoing the investigation.
#   5. Never invent a shortcut. Only encode a crossing that exists in game.
# Taverley / Falador wall gate  -  reported 2026-08-09
# The wall is a one-tile-thick north-south barrier on the EAST edge of x=2935,
# running y=3448..3455. Decoded from our own collision-map.zip, region 45_53:
# canMoveEast(2935, y) is false for every y in that span. The archway is the
# two-tile opening at y=3450 and y=3451 - the tiles north (y=3452+) and south
# (y=3449-) of it are solid gatehouse, and x=2936 is open eastward at both rows.
# The only thing stopping passage is the gate object on the 2935->2936 edge.
# Upstream carries 145 rows whose menu option mentions a Gate, so gates ARE
# modelled in general - but a search of x 2920-2955, y 3430-3475 returns ZERO
# rows of any kind. Confirmed in game by Mytharium: upstream's own Shortest Path
# detours here too, so this is an upstream data gap, not a fault in our reader.
# Without these rows the router walks around the whole wall, roughly doubling
# the trip between Taverley and Falador.
BASELINE
BASELINE
BASELINE
BASELINE
